comment: Targets of bin/build.sh. A target that does not exist yet is skipped, so a part lands before its workflow exists. block: the file carries the shared-block markers. table: the file carries the class-table markers. roles/aspects: the subset of lib/roles/*.md and lib/aspects/*.md stamped into that file (A23), by role name without the .md suffix. A key set to true whose marker pair is missing from an existing target fails the build, so a deleted marker is never a silent skip. fromBase: the target is the named source file, as this run stamped it, under the frontmatter lines of this entry; it carries no markers and is never hand-edited.

targets.comment: the class table of the base text is the generated region between the class-table markers; every other line of the base is hand-written
